remarks: Welcome to unit 818 at the Fountain Terrace association. One of the most sought after complexes in the city!! This beautifully updated unit provides ample space with an open living and dinning room floor plan, fully equipped kitchen complimented with quartz countertops, gas stove, built in microwave, dishwasher, breakfast bar, generous countertop space, bright and ready to move in immediately. Extra features provided with this lovely unit include heat, hot water, water, internet, and common laundry area. The in ground pool access and balcony are no short of additional convenient relaxation and enjoyment of the tenancy in the community. The building also offers elevator service, on site security and parking, and it is conveniently located within minutes from the train station, major highway, downtown and shopping centers. Tenant/s must have good credit.
